 Justin's Forecast: Mild Afternoons Ahead, Halloween Showers are Possible
 Channel 13 Weather Forecast | Monday, October 26 
 Prev 
 Next 
 Channel 13 Weather Forecast for October 26 
 By: 
 Justin Bruce 
 Posted 
 LAS VEGAS (KTNV) — MORNING: Partly cloudy with 50s and 60s early alongside light winds.
 AFTERNOON: Mainly sunny with light southwest breezes at 5-10 mph and highs in the upper 70s.
 EVENING: Mainly clear and falling into the 60s after 7 p.m.
 TONIGHT: Lows in the mid-to-upper 50s late.
 Tuesday brings morning sun and then some afternoon high clouds as south winds pick up to 10-20 mph. Wake-up temperatures in the 50s will reach the upper 70s to near 80° in the afternoon.
 Wednesday through the end of the week brings partly-to-mostly cloudy conditions, but we'll still see highs in the mid-and-upper 70s.
 Friday brings south winds at 10-20 mph and a 10% chance of a shower.
 Halloween is Saturday, and we see a 30% chance of passing showers in the afternoon and evening. After highs in the low 70s with south winds at 10-20 mph, trick-or-treat temperatures will be in the 60s.
 Rain opportunities increase to 60% Saturday night (low of 58°) through Sunday (high of only 66°).
 Sun protection is still advised between 11 a.m. and 3 p.m.; a hat, light-colored clothing, and sunscreen are important when you're outside. The UV index then is strong enough that a sunburn can happen in 45 minutes.
 The air quality forecast is good today and tomorrow.
